section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: 27 ## Sex During 1974, more than 60.0 per cent of total suicides were committed by male and less than 40.0 per cent by females. Exactly the same pattern was present in the 'Male' and 'Female' ratio during 1973. The 'Male' and 'Female' ratio in suicides for States was also the same as for the country as whole. The percentage of male involvement in 11 States, 5 Union Territories and 4 Metropolitan Cities was higher than the all-India average. For other States, there were variations in male-female ratio in comparison to the all-India average. The details are given in Table 7.
